name: Forge Grounds
summary: In the arid reaches of the Blasted Lands, the area outside the Nethergarde Mines functions as an Alliance logistical and support hub known as the Nethergarde Supply Camps. In the current era of 25 ADP, it remains under the stewardship of Nethergarde Keep to support ongoing excavation work.

sections.title: Outpost of the Keep
sections.body: Situated just outside the entrances of the Nethergarde Mines, this camp provides essential provisions, tools, and security for the miners working deep beneath the red hills of the Blasted Lands. Run under the authority of Nethergarde Keep, the staging area ensures a steady flow of materials needed to reinforce Alliance watchposts monitoring the Dark Portal. For travelers heading along the jagged ridges, the camp stands as one of the few signs of organized industry amid the blighted wilderness.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this camp?
faq.answer: The encampment exists to support the excavators and laborers operating within the nearby Nethergarde Mines. It provides a staging area for equipment, storage, and supplies necessary to sustain operations in the hostile environment of the Blasted Lands.
The grounds are maintained by the Alliance garrison based out of Nethergarde Keep, ensuring mining efforts proceed without disruption from local predators and hostile forces.

faq.q: Why is it sometimes referred to as the Forge Grounds?
faq.answer: While known in 25 ADP primarily as part of the Nethergarde supply infrastructure, the presence of metalworking tools, anvils, and mining logistics often leads travelers to refer to the staging area around the mine entrance by its forging works.

angles.text: The supply grounds secure critical material pipelines that keep Nethergarde Keep supplied against potential threats emerging from the Dark Portal.
Miners working nearby rely on this outpost as a staging ground before venturing into the mineral-rich tunnels beneath the Blasted Lands.
